content:
maria: Heads-up — scheduling a rolling node drain + NIC fw/kernel micropatch in us-east1-c tonight 23:30-00:45 UTC. Target pools: gradient-prod-gpu-pool (256 GPUs) and scaleburst-backup (48 GPUs). Trying to keep pool availability >= 90%. :calendar:

alex: ack. what's the stagger cadence? can we avoid >2% request errors for the api tier?

jordan: plan is 8-node cohorts, 10m stagger between cohorts, KV-cache reseed after each cohort. We'll keep one hot rack as canary.

maria: exact command we'll run (for runbook):
```
./maintenance.sh --region us-east1 --cohort-size 8 --stagger 10m \n  --pools gradient-prod-gpu-pool,scaleburst-backup \n  --postcheck kvcache-seed.sh --notify slack:eng-infra
```

kevin: If the canary sees >200ms p95 increase or >1% 5xx, abort and rollback via the playbook. ops-oncall will run health checks.

lia: cost note — if autoscaler bursts to on-demand during backfill we estimate ~$1.8k extra for the window. Flagging finance for possible chargeback. :money_with_wings:

ops-oncall: I'll be on call for the window. I pushed a preflight that simulates drain on staging at 21:15 UTC — results look good (kv cache reseed 95% success).

sre-bot: [deploy-bot] Preflight run completed: staging kvcache reseed 95.3% success, max p95 delta 42ms.

alex: quick checklist before start?

maria: checklist: 1) Lock rollout (no other infra deploys) 2) Push canary nodes into read-only 3) Confirm regional fallback routing rules 4) Notify support + customer-facing status page 5) Start drain window 23:30 UTC

jordan: added: make sure optimizer (batching) config persists across kernel update; some models have warmup penalty otherwise.

kevin: How aggressive are we on backfill? We currently allow burst to 120% for 15m then throttle to 105%. Want to keep cost curve predictable.

maria: agree — allow burst to 120% for immediate backfill then step down over 30m to normal thresholds. We'll tag the extra capacity with maintenance:1766668888 for billing.

ops-oncall: I'll run the smoke script after each cohort: `scripts/smoke_check.sh --region us-east1 --pool gradient-prod` and report p95/p99 to this thread.

lia: I'll open a finance note with expected delta and who to bill.

alex: leaving a reminder: if we see persistent NIC drops on >2 nodes in a cohort, we'll pause and escalate to hw-team. Don't attempt live PCIe reset unless hw-team approves.

maria: noted. We'll start at 23:30. I'll post live status updates here and the status page. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
